# Same People, Two Plans

<!-- STEP id="parliamentary" -->
## Parliamentary Democracy

In a **parliamentary democracy**, people elect the legislature but not the executive.

Members of the executive are also part of the legislature, and the executive is accountable to it.

<!-- STEP id="presidential" -->
## Presidential Democracy

In a **presidential democracy**, the executive is independent of the legislature. The President is elected by the people and is accountable to the people.

The United States of America works this way.

<!-- STEP id="telltale-question" -->
## One Question

One question separates the two: **who does the executive answer to?**

If it answers to the legislature, the system is parliamentary. If the President answers to the people, it is presidential. Tap a part to light it.
